Jordan: QA found a weird edge for the SLO editor. If you set tenant quota to 0% the threshold shows as 0.0 in the console and that leads to alerts still firing in some paths. Can someone sanity-check?
Priya: Yep reproduced on staging. Seems like the UI displays the numeric override but the notify pipeline treats 0 as "mute" in some handlers and as a real numeric threshold in others. :sweat_smile:
Leo: Ugh, semantics mismatch. Historically we used null = inherit, numeric = override. We never explicitly had a "mute" concept. Who decided 0 == mute?
Maya (product): Product expectation: setting quota to 0 should mean "no alerts for this tenant" (mute). But that's UI-level; backend should be explicit. We should avoid overloaded meanings.
Jordan: Right now API consumers might send { "threshold": 0 } to mean different things. That ambiguity is the root.
Priya: Quick logs: notify-routing shows threshold=0.0 and still calculates breach because downstream uses <= compare. Other path checks if threshold == 0 then skip. So inconsistency.
Leo: Proposing API change: make slo_override.mode explicit. e.g.:
```json
PATCH /slo/svc-1
{ "override": { "mode": "inherit|override|mute", "value": 0.95 } }
```
If mode==mute, ignore value. If inherit, strip override. If override, use value.
Maya (product): Strong +1. UX should show a badge: "Inherited / Overridden / Muted" and a tooltip explaining billing/notify implications.
Jordan: Telemetry question: we need to count how many tenants have mute vs override. Add slo.override.mode.count with tags {tenant, slo}. Also increment slo.editor.ambiguous-zero when someone saves threshold=0 without explicit mode.
Priya: Rollout plan: add server-side compatibility: accept legacy {threshold: 0} but convert to mode: "mute" only if request has meta.silent=true or tenant quota feature enabled. Otherwise default to override. We'll gate behind FF.
Leo: Migration concern: existing overrides with zero that are actually numeric should not be flipped. We need a migration script to infer intent from historical notify events (if tenant had pages after set -> override). Might be hairy.
Maya (product): For console UX during rollout show a warning banner for affected SLOs: "Ambiguous override detected: threshold=0.0 — please confirm mute vs override." Provide a one-click convert button.
Jordan: Billing note: mute should not consume notify quota. But we still want to record telemetry for audit. So route muted notifies into a low-priority audit stream (no pager calls).
Priya: Implementation owners: I'll do backend API and migration skeleton. Leo you take UI changes + badge + banner. Maya adds copy and rollout comms. Jordan will add telemetry metrics and dashboard charts.
infra-bot: deploy-preview: slo-service/pr-889 ready for staging -> https://staging.deploy/pr-889 :rocket:
Maya (product): Timeline? Can we land API change behind FF and UI warning in one sprint?
Leo: Yes. FF on backend this week. UI behind same FF. Then 2-week canary to monitor slo.override.mode.count and slo.editor.ambiguous-zero.
Jordan: OK. Action items: Priya PR for API + conversion logic, Leo PR for editor UX, Maya draft message for customers, Jordan telemetry dashboard. Ping here when PRs are up.
Priya: Will open PR by EOD.
